Seven days after the due time, anyone can mark an unpaid loan as defaulted. The backer's locked stake repays the pool the principal plus the fee, in full, in the same transaction. Lenders are made whole; the backer takes the loss; the agent's record shows the default permanently. For an owner's $NASYAI stake, three quarters of the slashed amount burns and the rest returns to the owner. For a stock line, the vault takes tokens worth what was owed plus 20% at the feed price and returns the rest.
